fact: Diggermattock Hall is a well-lit cavern occupied by roughly two dozen Svirfneblin.
source_quote: Roughly two dozen Svirfneblin occupied the well-lit cavern.
subject: Diggermattock Hall

fact: Dorbo Diggermattock is a male Svirfeblin who introduces himself to the party.
source_quote: The male leader introduced himself: “My name is Dorbo.
subject: Dorbo Diggermattock

fact: Senni Diggermattock is a female Svirfeblin identified as Dorbo's assistant and Quartermaster.
source_quote: And over here is my assistant, Senni.
subject: Senni Diggermattock

fact: The party initially introduces themselves as the Emerald Vanguard.
source_quote: The party initially blurted out “the Emerald Vanguard”
subject: party introduction

fact: The party confuses their identity with the Ember Vanguard and the Emerald Enclave.
source_quote: became tangled in a discussion of the Emerald Vanguard, Ember Vanguard, and Emerald Enclave
subject: name confusion

fact: The party recognizes one of the proposed names is associated with a faction blamed for destroying a capital city.
source_quote: one of those names was associated with a faction blamed for destroying a capital city
subject: tainted faction name

fact: The party introduces themselves as adventurers trying to find their way home and reach the Overbright.
source_quote: introduced themselves simply as adventurers trying to find their way home and reach the Overbright.
subject: revised introduction

fact: Dorbo and Senni engage in a heated private argument involving muttering and finger-pointing.
source_quote: Dorbo and Quartermaster Senni Diggermattock responded with muttering, finger-pointing, and an apparently heated private argument.
subject: leaders' consultation

fact: A party member asks if the clan has a side quest involving oozes, citing Jimjar's warning.
source_quote: the party openly asked whether the clan had a side quest involving oozes and volunteered their interest
subject: ooze quest offer

fact: Senni Diggermattock accepts the offer to deal with the ooze problem in exchange for helping the party reach the Overbright.
source_quote: our community is suffering from an ooze problem. And since you so graciously volunteered to go look at it, we won’t feel at all encumbered or guilty about asking you to do that before we help you.”
subject: Senni's acceptance

fact: Glabbagool declares he is a gelatinous cube, not an ooze, to distinguish himself from the pests.
source_quote: Well, I’m not an ooze. I’m a gelatinous cube. A totally different species.”
subject: Glabbagool's distinction

fact: Glabbagool identifies himself as the friendly type.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The party argues that gelatinous cubes have higher viscosity and can maintain a square form unlike oozes.
source_quote: gelatinous cubes have much higher viscosity than oozes and can maintain a square form
subject: viscosity argument

fact: Glabbagool declares he is better than oozes after hearing the square shape argument.
source_quote: I knew there was a reason I was just better than them.”
subject: Glabbagool's vanity

fact: Stone tables in Diggermattock Hall are covered with maps and documents.
source_quote: stone tables covered with maps and documents
subject: maps and documents

fact: Shambling mounds do not sweep up and retain objects the way gelatinous cubes do.
source_quote: shambling mounds did not sweep up and retain objects the way gelatinous cubes did
subject: Shambling Mound

fact: Glabbagool does not eat oozes but sometimes punches them.
source_quote: No, no, I don’t eat oozes. I mean, I do punch them sometimes, but no, I don’t eat oozes.”
subject: Glabbagool

fact: Glabbagool extends a pseudopod to demonstrate his ability to strike objects.
source_quote: He then extended a pseudopod to demonstrate that he could strike things as well as absorb them.
subject: Glabbagool demonstration
